name: AnswerNet
desc:
Inbound Call Center Agent (Technical Support Representative) | $16.00/hr | Inbound/Outbound, No Sales Expectations
Company: AnswerNet
Industry: Business Process Outsourcing / Telecommunications Customer & Technical Support
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 You'd be supporting customers of a low-cost wireless phone service, handling both inbound and outbound calls using a computer-based softphone. Think of yourself as the person who keeps someone's cell service running smoothly, whether that's troubleshooting a connectivity issue, verifying their identity securely, walking them through their account or billing, or calming things down when a customer is frustrated. You'll use an AI-assisted tool for real-time troubleshooting guidance while staying focused on the actual conversation, and you'll need to follow strict verification and security standards (like CPNI and PCI DSS) since you're handling sensitive account and payment information on every call.
assessment: Yes, explicitly required. Pre-hire assessments include typing, spelling, grammar, listening, and comprehension tests.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: High School Diploma or equivalent required.
Required Experience: At least 1 year of work experience in a call center or customer service environment.
Preferred Experience: Not separately broken out.
Required Skills:
Excellent written and verbal communication with genuine empathy for callers
Strong interpersonal skills and active listening
Typing, data capture, and entry with proper grammar and spelling; minimum 25 WPM
Ability to multitask, manage time, and work independently
Comfortable reading from scripts while still sounding natural
Comfortable with calls being monitored and recorded, and performance closely tracked
Flexible with shift and role changes based on business needs
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone with at least a year of call center or customer service experience who's comfortable in a fast-paced, back-to-back call environment
Someone genuinely empathetic who can de-escalate a frustrated customer calmly
Someone who already has, or can invest in, the specific home tech setup this role requires
Someone available for evening and weekend hours, since the schedule runs into the evening on weekdays and covers both weekend days
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone who can't meet the strict technical requirements, especially the Windows-only, dual-monitor, wired-internet setup, no Macs, Chromebooks, or virtual machines allowed
Anyone who needs a traditional daytime, weekday-only schedule
Anyone uncomfortable having every call monitored, recorded, and closely evaluated for quality
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Inbound and outbound call handling
Customer account verification
Technical troubleshooting support
De-escalation and conflict resolution
Billing and account management support
Real-time documentation accuracy
Multitasking in a fast-paced environment
Data entry and typing accuracy
Customer relationship management
Compliance and security standards adherence
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
 Application → Assessment (typing, spelling, grammar, listening, comprehension) → Phone screen → Final interview. Total time to hire averages 3 to 15 days.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about your call center or customer service experience and what a typical day looked like.
How do you stay calm and effective when a customer is frustrated or upset?
Walk us through how you'd troubleshoot a technical issue you're not immediately familiar with.
What's your comfort level reading from a script while still sounding genuine and natural?
How do you feel about having your calls monitored and recorded as part of quality review?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $16.00/hr.
Shift: 40 hours per week required. Monday through Friday, 12:00 PM to 10:00 PM Eastern; Saturday and Sunday, 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM Eastern. Schedules are subject to change based on client needs. Paid 15-minute breaks for 4-hour shifts, 60-minute unpaid lunches.
Benefits: Available after 60 days for full-time employees. Specific plan details not itemized in posting, confirm directly.
Equipment Provided: Not provided. Participant needs their own Windows 10 or 11 PC (no Mac, Chromebook, or virtual machines), 8GB RAM minimum, quad-core processor minimum, USB wired headset, dual monitors, and wired internet at minimum 80 Mbps down/15 Mbps up. Satellite, hotspots, MiFi devices, and WiFi extenders/boosters are explicitly not allowed.
Felony Friendly?: Not stated as friendly or unfriendly, but a 7-year background and criminal check is required, which is a longer lookback window than many other postings in this database.
Drug Test: Not stated.
Notes: This role has one of the stricter technical setups and background check requirements in the database, so walk a participant through both carefully before they apply. The evening and weekend schedule is also a real commitment, not flexible or optional. On the positive side, the pay is steady and the training is paid, and the AI-assisted troubleshooting tool suggests a genuinely supported work environment rather than being left to figure things out alone.
Career Pathway: Not stated directly in posting. Reasonable inferred path: Technical Support Representative → Senior TSR → Team Lead → Quality Assurance Specialist, though this is an estimate, not confirmed by AnswerNet directly.
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
